notes.title: Join Ex Sanguis first playtests!
notes.content:
Join our playtests!
For those who missed it, Ex Sanguis is a strategy game with dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!



To join the playtest, you simply need to click on "Request Access" on the game's store page. Go and join our playtest now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/e7438836aec44737669cdfe84ba81c955894b9c8.jpg"]


Ex Sanguis exclusive images
Look at Ex Sanguis' first teaser trailer for TactiCon!
[previewyoutube="HWd1XgNhKFY;full"][/previewyoutube]


We're also very pleased to share brand new visual assets of the game with you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/e031a4e6a2866b4aaf820b906a7f2498623db993.png"]

The game is inspired by our previous game Othercide, a dark fantasy turn-based tactics game in a scattered world. It is currently available on all platforms if you want to have a look!
